scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Validate that the hero section renders with headline, subheadline, and primary call-to-action button as specified in REQ-1

steps.description: Load the homepage at the root URL '/'
steps.context: User arrives at the application for the first time

steps.description: Check that the hero section is prominently displayed above the fold
Confirm a clear headline explaining the URL shortening service is visible
Confirm a supporting subheadline with value proposition is displayed
Check that a primary call-to-action button (e.g., 'Get Started Free') is visible and styled prominently

test_cases.input: Render homepage component and query for hero section elements
test_cases.expected: Hero section container is present in the DOM with appropriate CSS classes

test_cases.input: Query for headline element within hero section
test_cases.expected: Headline text is rendered and contains meaningful content about URL shortening

test_cases.input: Query for subheadline element within hero section
test_cases.expected: Subheadline text is rendered with supporting value proposition

test_cases.input: Query for primary CTA button in hero section
test_cases.expected: Button is rendered with text like 'Get Started' or 'Sign Up' and has onClick handler

test_cases.input: Render homepage and query for features section container

test_cases.expected: Router navigates to /login route
